title: SmolVLAConfig (smolvla)
description: SmolVLAConfig(n_obs_steps: int = 1, input_features: dict[str, lerobot.configs.types.PolicyFeature] | None = <factory>, output_features: dict[str, lerobot.configs.types.PolicyFeature] | None = <factory>, device: str | None = None, dtype: torch.dtype | None = None, use_amp: bool = False, use_peft: bool = False, push_to_hub: bool = True, repo_id: str | None = None, private: bool | None = None, tags: list[str] | None = None, license: str | None = None, pretrained_path: pathlib.Path | None = None, pretrained_revision: str | None = None, chunk_size: int = 50, n_action_steps: int = 50, normalization_mapping: dict[str, lerobot.configs.types.NormalizationMode] = <factory>, max_state_dim: int = 32, max_action_dim: int = 32, resize_imgs_with_padding: tuple[int, int] = (512, 512), empty_cameras: int = 0, adapt_to_pi_aloha: bool = False, use_delta_joint_actions_aloha: bool = False, tokenizer_max_length: int = 48, num_steps: int = 10, use_cache: bool = True, freeze_vision_encoder: bool = True, train_expert_only: bool = True, train_state_proj: bool = True, optimizer_lr: float = 0.0001, optimizer_betas: tuple[float, float] = (0.9, 0.95), optimizer_eps: float = 1e-08, optimizer_weight_decay: float = 1e-10, optimizer_grad_clip_norm: float = 10, optimizer_fused: bool | None = None, scheduler_warmup_steps: int = 1000, scheduler_decay_steps: int = 30000, scheduler_decay_lr: float = 2.5e-06, vlm_model_name: str = 'HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM2-500M-Video-Instruct', load_vlm_weights: bool = False, add_image_special_tokens: bool = False, attention_mode: str = 'cross_attn', prefix_length: int = -1, pad_language_to: str = 'longest', num_expert_layers: int = -1, num_vlm_layers: int = 16, self_attn_every_n_layers: int = 2, expert_width_multiplier: float = 0.75, min_period: float = 0.004, max_period: float = 4.0, rtc_config: lerobot.policies.rtc.configuration_rtc.RTCConfig | None = None, compile_model: bool = False, compile_mode: str = 'max-autotune')

n_obs_steps.description: Number of environment steps worth of observations to pass to the policy (takes the current step and additional steps going back).

normalization_mapping.description: A dictionary that maps from a str value of FeatureType (e.g., "STATE", "VISUAL") to a corresponding NormalizationMode (e.g., NormalizationMode.MIN_MAX)

max_state_dim.description: Shorter state and action vectors will be padded

empty_cameras.description: Add empty images. Used by smolvla_aloha_sim which adds the empty left and right wrist cameras in addition to the top camera.

adapt_to_pi_aloha.description: Converts the joint and gripper values from the standard Aloha space to the space used by the pi internal runtime which was used to train the base model.

use_delta_joint_actions_aloha.description: Converts joint dimensions to relative values with respect to the current state before passing to the model. Gripper dimensions will remain in absolute values.

load_vlm_weights.description: Set to False in case of training the expert from scratch. True when init from pretrained SmolVLA weights

add_image_special_tokens.description: Whether to use special image tokens around image features.

num_expert_layers.description: Less or equal to 0 is the default where the action expert has the same number of layers of VLM. Otherwise the expert have less layers.

num_vlm_layers.description: Number of layers used in the VLM (first num_vlm_layers layers)

expert_width_multiplier.description: The action expert hidden size (wrt to the VLM)

min_period.description: sensitivity range for the timestep used in sine-cosine positional encoding

excluded.input_features: derived from the dataset version schema by the worker
excluded.output_features: derived from the dataset version schema by the worker
excluded.device: always 'cuda'; the GPU is chosen by the scheduler (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES)
excluded.dtype: torch.dtype is not JSON-serialisable; precision is controlled by train.mixed_precision
excluded.use_peft: set implicitly when train.peft is provided
excluded.push_to_hub: always false; Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action on a model
excluded.repo_id: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.private: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.tags: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.license: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.pretrained_path: set from RunCreate.init_from (model or checkpoint) by the worker
excluded.pretrained_revision: set from RunCreate.init_from by the worker
excluded.rtc_config: inference-time Real-Time-Chunking option, not a training hyperparameter
excluded.compile_model: torch.compile is disabled on the 2-GPU box (P40 unsupported by inductor)
excluded.compile_mode: torch.compile is disabled on the 2-GPU box
